“Ah, mister secretary!” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, walking over to Redtail. Redtail smiles, lip-syncing “Mister Burr, sir!”

+|hPh[],8C{`)(JYRkUt.text:
- 1 -

Night, Camp

“Ah, mister secretary!” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, approaching Redtail. “Mister Burr, sir!” Redtail lip-syncs back with a smile. Introduce the MAP as this is going on.


- 2 -

Night, Camp

“Did ya hear the news about good ol’ General Mursor?” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, sitting down. Redtail looks confused, lip-syncing, “No.”


- 3 -

Night, Camp

“Y’know Clemons Street?” Tigerclaw lip-syncs with an optional kind of movement. Redtail nods. “Yeah.” Tigerclaw gets up. “They renamed it after the Mursor legacy,” he lip-syncs.


- 4 -

Night, Camp

“Sure,” Redtail lip-syncs with an awkward smile. Tigerclaw moves muzzle-to-muzzle with Redtail, lip-syncing, “And all he had to do was die.” Redtail pulls away, lip-syncing “That’s a lot less work,” with a nervous expression.

- 5 -

Night, Camp

“We oughtta give it a try,” Tigerclaw lip-syncs menacingly. Redtail gives an awkward laugh and tries to move away when Tigerclaw bars him, lip-syncing, “So how you gonna get your depth plan through?”

- 6 -

Night, Camp

“I guess I’m gonna finally have to listen to you,” Redtail lip-syncs, staring at the ground nervously. Tigerclaw lifts a claw. “Really?” he lip-syncs.


- 7 -

Day, Training Hollow

“Talk less,” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, pushing his muzzle in Ravenpaw’s face. “Smile more,” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, smiling. Ravenpaw let’s out a nervous chuckle.


- 8 -

Day, Training Hollow

“Do whatever it takes to get ma plan on the congress board,” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, facing away from Ravenpaw, who’s fur bushes up at “congress”.


- 9 -

Day, Camp

“Madison and Jefferson are merciless,” Lionheart lip-syncs, shocked. Tigerclaw walks past him, lip-syncing “Well, hate the sin, love the sinner.”


- 10 -

Day, Camp

“Hamilton!” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, stepping forward. “I’m sorry, Burr, I gotta go,” Ravenpaw lip-syncs as he walks away. “But-“ he lip-syncs again, and the screen flashes to Firepaw and Greypaw eating with him as he lip-syncs, “Desicions are happening over dinner.”


- 11 -

Day, Training Hollow

PMV TIME! Firepaw and Greypaw walk into the training hollow mischievously. Tigerclaw frowns at them. He looks at Firepaw muzzle-to-muzzle.


- 12 -

Day, Training Hollow

Tigerclaw huffs as Firepaw does really well with training. He lip-syncs, “Bros,” in front of the two.


- 13 -

Day, Camp

Bluestar smiles at Firepaw from on the HighRock. Tigerclaw looks shocked, then crouches, mad.


- 14 -

Day, Camp

Greypaw is hanging with Ravenpaw. Tigerclaw looks thoughtful, then walks away menacingly.

- 15 -

Night, Forest

Tigerclaw lip-syncs, “No one else was in the room where it happened, the room where it happened,” as he walked through the forest, the camera’s angle at the side of his face. Then the camera angle switches to the front of his face as he stops, still lip-syncing.


- 16 -

Night, Forest Flashback

Screen turns white and once the colour returns have Tigerclaw clinging on to Redtail’s body with his jaws. Close up to Ravenpaw turns and runs offscreen

- 17 -

Night, Camp Flashback

Ravenpaw runs into camp and collapses. Tigerclaw walks to his side, gazing up at a shocked Bluestar but still carrying Redtail.


- 18 -

Day, Forest

“Alexander was at Washington’s doorstep one day in distress and disarray,” Longtail lip-syncs. At “distress” have it pan to Ravenpaw looking scared next to Greypaw and Firepaw. Tigerclaw flattens his ears.


- 19 -

Day, Forest

Longtail licks his paw and stops to lip-sync, “Alexander said,” and then have Ravenpaw’s face over Longtail’s as he lip-syncs “I’ve no-one else to go,” and hides as Longtail carries on lip-syncing.

- 20 -

Day, Forest Flashback

Longtail walks over to Darkstripe and lip-syncs, “Listen, I know you hate him, but let’s hear what he has to say.” At “I arranged the meeting” have Longtail whisper in loads of cats’ ears until the end of the part.

- 21 -

Day, Forest

“But!” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, shoving Longtail to the ground. Tigerclaw continues to lip-sync as he pins Longtail down with a big smile on his face. Have him make dramatic swaggering movements as well. Remember that Longtail is smiling too.


- 22 -

“No one else was in the room where it happened, the room where it happened, the room where it happened” Tigerclaw lip-syncs, getting off of Longtail and walking through the forest with him.


- 23 -


PMV time! They have their back turned to the camera as they watch the happy scenes in camp.


- 24 -

Night, Forest

Darkstripe is talking and Tigerclaw is lip-syncing while Darkstripe has his back turned to the camera.


- 25 -

Night, Gathering

Brokenstar is talking and ThunderClab lip-syncs the clamour. Tigerclaw, however, is lip-syncing the rest except from “meanwhile”.


- 26 -

Night, Gathering

Tigerclaw lip-syncs “Then Jefferson approaches with the dinner and invite, and Madison responds with the gin and the invite.” Brokenstar lip-syncs “Maybe we can solve one problem with another, and win a victory to the soviuners, and other words,” to Crookedstar, who lip-syncs, “Oh,” as he turns away.


- 27 -

Night, Gathering

“Oh, I suppose,” lip-syncs Crookedstar with a skeptical expression. Brokenstar smiles and lip-syncs “Wouldn’t you like to work a little closer to home?” with a plotting expression on.


- 28 -

Night, Gathering

Crookedstar lip-syncs, “Actually, I would!” Brokenstar lip-syncs “Well, I appose an atonement,” and Crookedstar gives him a questioning glance, lip-syncing, “And you’ll provide him his phone?”


- 29 -

Night, Gathering

Brokenstar tilts his head, lip-syncing, “We’ll see how it goes.” At “see” he tilts his head back. “Let’s go,” Crookedstar lip-syncs with a smile. Brokenstar nods and turns his head to Tallstar, who lip-syncs “No!”

- 30 -

Night, Camp

PMV time! ThunderClan piles into camp. Tigerclaw’s eyes look for Ravenpaw. He spots him sitting a bit away from Firepaw and Greypaw. Tigerclaw smiles evilly and stalks offscreen.


- 31 -

Night, Camp

PMV time! Tigerclaw shoulders through the camp. First the view is from the side and then to the front as he is still grinning evilly.


- 32 -

Day, Camp

Tigerclaw lip-syncs to a bunch of ThunderClan cats. At the end show him pointing at Ravenpaw with his tail, who looks away at his paws.


- 33 -

Black Background

ThunderClan lip-syncs “Click—boom where it happened,”and Tigerclaw comes up in front of them from below, lip-syncing, “And no-one else was in the room where it happened.”


- 34 -

Black Background

ThunderClan chases Ravenpaw. Whitestorm angrily lip-syncs as he tackles into Ravenpaw, who dodges looking startled and confused.


- 35 -

Black Background/ Day, Forest

ThunderClan still chases after Ravenpaw. Brackenfur lip-syncs furiously as he swipes at Ravenpaw’s muzzle. After that, Ravenpaw jumps into the forest, panting. Tigerclaw smiles evilly at him.


- 36 -

Day, Forest

Tigerclaw lip-syncs, “Don’t you know it doesn’t matter where you put the US capital?” Ravenpaw lip-syncs sadly, walking away, “‘cause we’ll have the banks. We’re in the same spot.”


- 37 -

Day, Camp

Ravenpaw walks over to Firepaw and Greypaw. After “you got more than you gave” they are on the mission to Barley’s barn. Show Ravenpaw’s scared and then determined face.


- 38 -

Day, The Barn

Ravenpaw lip-syncs “But you don’t get to win unless you’re playing the game,” as Greypaw and Firepaw leave. At “you get love for it,” show him cuddling with Barley. At “you get hate for it,” show him being sneered at by some barn cats, and at “You get nothing if you wait for it, wait!” show Tigerclaw standing over what could’ve been Ravenpaw’s dead body.


- 39 -

Night, The Barn

“God help and forgive me,” Ravenpaw lip-syncs half-sadly, half happily, then looks to the barn, lip-syncing, “I wanna build something that’s gonna outlive me.”


- 40 -

Black Background/Night, BloodClan Alley

Tigerclaw walks over to Scourge’s alley. All the BloodClan cats start hissing as he advances, but Scourge just blinks calmly, and the BloodClan cat’s ease back, looking calm

- 41 -

Night, BloodClan Alley

Tigerclaw lip-syncs softly but with a grin on his face. At the end of the part, show Scourge smiling and nodding.


- 42 -

Night, Forest

Tigerclaw and Scourge walk into the forest, Tigerclaw lip-syncing “I….wanna be in the room where it happened!” while BloodClan, including Scourge, lip-sync, “Room where it happened, room where it happened, room where it happened.”


- 43 -

Night, Forest

With the same lip-sync, Tigerclaw pads forward and lip-syncs in Firestar’s angry face. Scourge unsheathes his claws and close up to Tigerclaw’s mouth as he smiles


- 44 -

Night, Forest

The BloodClan cats run into Tigerclaw’s rouges. Alarmed, Tigerclaw looks at Scourge, who licks a paw lazily.


- 45 -

Night, Forest

The BloodClan cats begin to circle Tigerclaw, lip-syncing, “I wanna be in the room where it happens, the room where it happens,” as Scourge advances in front of him. Redtail’s ghost emerges from the right and Ravenpaw pushes his way through to the left. Tigerclaw lip-syncs, “I’ve got to be,” as he gazes up at the stars fearfully.


- 46 -

Night, Forest/StarClan

Scourge kills Tigerclaw with no blood included. The screen flashes white and StarClan cats lip-sync “The art of compromise,” and Tigerclaw crouches defensively.


- 47 -

StarClan

StarClan cats narrow their eyes angrily as Tigerclaw slashes one’s nose. He flicks his tail unhappily.


- 48 -

StarClan/Dark Forest

StarClan cat’s lip-syncs, “We dream of a brand new start,” as they bar Tigerclaw’s path to the Dark Forest. He lip-syncs, “But we dream in the dark for the most part!” and pushes past them, jumping in.


- 49 to 51-

Dark Forest

Tigerclaw running through the Dark Forest, lip-syncing. Add some creative things here to make your part different from any other.


- 52 -

Tigerclaw stops running, still lip-syncing, as he faces the camera. At “click-boom” have him run forward and swipe at the screen.


- Credits -

I do this bit :D
